response.sql:
WITH college_income AS (
    SELECT m.college, SUM(i.amount) AS total_income
    FROM income AS i
    JOIN member AS mem ON mem.member_id = i.link_to_member
    JOIN major AS m ON m.major_id = mem.link_to_major
    GROUP BY m.college
)
SELECT college,
       total_income,
       CAST(total_income AS REAL) / SUM(total_income) OVER () AS income_fraction
FROM college_income;

assumptions.assumption: Income and college totals are computed over records that link to a member and that member links to a major; records with missing links are excluded as requested. The fraction is an unrounded decimal ratio.
